title.zh: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit
title.en: Zano rolls blockchain back a month after Gateway Address exploit

current_state.zh: Following a Gateway Address exploit that let unauthorized ZANO and Freedom Dollar enter circulation, Zano restarted its blockchain at block 3,833,000 — just before Hard Fork 6 — rolling back about a month of history and invalidating legitimate transactions from that period.
current_state.en: Following a Gateway Address exploit that let unauthorized ZANO and Freedom Dollar enter circulation, Zano restarted its blockchain at block 3,833,000 — just before Hard Fork 6 — rolling back about a month of history and invalidating legitimate transactions from that period.
